info.title: AI Knowledge Assistant local API
info.description: Implemented through S04. Pending uploads become complete source-aware vector generations when AI is configured. Exact semantic search returns stored passages and source locations. Reprocess/search may incur embedding cost. Chat and original downloads remain unavailable. Local single API process only.

200.description: Local dependencies and AI configuration are ready; no paid health calls.

post.summary: Search ready passages by exact cosine similarity
post.description: JSON only; no query parameters. Trimmed query: 1–2000 UTF-16 characters and at most 512 cl100k_base tokens. topK defaults to configured 5, range 1–10. Optional documentIds: 1–20 unique existing UUIDs. Ready/profile/current-run and document filters apply before limiting, then the provisional configured similarity cutoff (default 0.30) applies. Scores rank passages, not factual confidence. No eligible documents skips embedding. Each socket client is limited to 10 searches/minute (configurable downward); full shared AI capacity returns immediate 429. Whole search uses ASK_TIMEOUT_MS (default 65000), including database checks and provider retries. Plain-text excerpts contain at most 1000 UTF-16 characters at Unicode boundaries; locations identify full chunks.

200.description: Ranked passages or an explicit successful evidence limitation.

source.excerpt:
# Operations
Maintenance is Sunday at 02:00 UTC.

429.description: RATE_LIMITED or AI_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED. Retry-After is always present.

error.message: Too many requests. Try again shortly.

502.description: AI_UPSTREAM_ERROR for provider failure; AI_OUTPUT_INVALID for an invalid query embedding.

error.message: AI_UPSTREAM_ERROR for provider failure; AI_OUTPUT_INVALID for an invalid query embedding.

503.description: AI_NOT_CONFIGURED, EMBEDDING_PROFILE_MISMATCH, or SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE. Failures never become empty evidence.

error.message: AI_NOT_CONFIGURED, EMBEDDING_PROFILE_MISMATCH, or SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE. Failures never become empty evidence.

504.description: Search exceeded its deadline or a provider attempt timed out.

error.message: Search exceeded its deadline or a provider attempt timed out.

post.summary: Store one validated original and pending metadata
post.description: Exactly one file and no fields. PDF header or strict nonbinary UTF-8 text must agree with .pdf/.txt/.md/.markdown suffix and MIME. Empty/generic MIME is allowed. Defaults: 10 MiB/file, two concurrent streams, 60-second upload deadline, 10 upload/reprocess requests/minute combined. Admission serializes 100-document/200-MiB/five-pending quotas. All may be configured downward. Upload returns pending; background processing sends canonical chunk text to OpenAI when configured.

500.description: Document storage is unavailable. Database failures use INTERNAL_ERROR.

error.message: Document storage is unavailable. Database failures use INTERNAL_ERROR.

get.summary: List documents by descending creation time and UUID
get.description: Includes deleting documents. Defaults to 120 list/detail/delete requests per minute combined, configurable downward. Cursor is signed, bound to the status filter, and expires when the API restarts.

delete.summary: Invalidate evidence and finish original/metadata cleanup
delete.description: No body. Missing rows/files are idempotent success. Failures leave deleting metadata inspectable where possible; retry DELETE to resume.

post.summary: Clear a ready/failed generation and schedule processing again
post.description: No body or query. Requires a readable original and pending capacity. Atomically clears old evidence and assigns a new run. Shares the upload request limit. Re-embedding may incur cost.

202.description: Pending metadata with old evidence invalidated.

409.description: DOCUMENT_BUSY for pending/processing/deleting; CAPACITY_EXCEEDED for pending capacity; ORIGINAL_FILE_MISSING if the original cannot be found.

error.message: DOCUMENT_BUSY for pending/processing/deleting; CAPACITY_EXCEEDED for pending capacity; ORIGINAL_FILE_MISSING if the original cannot be found.

Error409.description: Document capacity is full. Delete a document before uploading.

error.message: Document capacity is full. Delete a document before uploading.

Error413.description: Document exceeds the upload size limit.

error.message: Document exceeds the upload size limit.

Error422.description: Document must contain nonempty, nonbinary UTF-8 text.

error.message: Document must contain nonempty, nonbinary UTF-8 text.

Error429.description: Too many requests. Try again shortly.

error.message: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
